pages.text: Once you wield a completed soul weapon, you will notice a new bar on your HUD. This is your $(thing)Soul Gauge$().$(br2)Deal damage to fill it. The more soul energy stored, the more powerful your weapon becomes.$(br2)However, soul energy fades quickly if you stop holding the weapon. Keep fighting to keep your power.

pages.title: Overflow
pages.text: You may notice a portion of your soul bar glows differently. That $(thing)overflow$() section drains on its own even while you are holding the weapon, and this decay stacks with the normal decay when you put the weapon away.$(br2)The best time to use your skills is while you have overflow energy — spending it there has the least impact on your sustained combat ability.
